method: Exact-phrase keyword searches for each firm name found the advertiser pages; each investor-facing advertiser page's library total was then recorded by page id and the listings returned were reviewed. Unrelated advertisers that matched a name were excluded.

corrections.text: Lankin was marked as having more ads than were read. The library showed 36 active ads on its page and all 36 were read, so its count is complete; only Equiton's page (56 listed, 50 read) was incomplete.

The return-figure and minimum counts first came from ad text only. They now also count figures printed on the ad images and video frames: Skyline Wealth Management showed a return figure and the $50,000 minimum on all 16 investor ads (counted as 0 and 1 before), and Lankin showed a return figure on 32 of 36 (28 before). The Skyline recommendation and the Skyline destination note were rewritten to match.
